findings.recommendation: `order_summaries` runs one `orders_of_customer` query, then one `lines_of_order` query per order — up to 101 database round trips per call, on a path the proposal says runs on every customer page view; the cost grows linearly with the number of orders (capped at 100) and with traffic. `Db` already offers `lines_of_orders(&[i64])` (`api/src/db.rs:31`, `WHERE order_id = ANY($1)`): collect the order ids, fetch all lines in one query, sum the totals per `order_id` in a `HashMap`, then build the summaries in the orders' original order (`ORDER BY id DESC`), so the output order and the error behaviour stay the same. Two queries per call whatever the number of orders.
